name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Implementation Specialist
summary: Customer onboarding and implementation professional with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and service-business environments. Owns the end-to-end post-sale journey for high-volume and high-value account portfolios, partnering closely with sales teams to ensure a seamless handoff, and has personally onboarded 25+ SaaS clients per month at 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets. Proficient across HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel, with a consistent record of translating complex product capability into fast, confident customer activation.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on training.
Manage up to 3 concurrent client engagements simultaneously as a solo operator, personally handling delivery, technical setup, and account expansion for each.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation management solutions.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Carried a combined sales and implementation load in year two, after the role expanded from a primarily sales focus in year one, working the full handoff from close to activation.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate — Google / Coursera (2024)
